caption: Most people don’t have a sleep problem
transcript: My friend, most people don't have a sleep problem. They have a mind that never learned how to slow down. Tonight, I want to share with you the simple ritual I give only to my closest students, because sleep is where the real healing begins. First, the Chi release breath. Lie down and breathe like this. Inhale four seconds. Hold two. Exhale six to eight. Do this eight times. On every exhale, think, nothing from today can reach me now. This tells your nervous system you are safe. Second, calm the wandering mind. Drink warm lemon balm tea 30 minutes before bed. If the mind is very restless, the lemon balm extract works faster and deeper. Use it slowly with intention. Third, the 21 word mantra. Before closing your eyes, repeat. My day is complete. My mind can rest. My body knows what to do. Feel the body sink. Feel the mind soften. My friend, sleep doesn't come when you chase it. It comes when you allow it. If you want my deeper night healing routine, comment, sleep.
